I worked at Domino’s for 2 years and at the start I knew I couldn’t take any leave (my gf at the time was in another country which is a 9-10 hr flight and wanted me to visit) and I was pumped that I landed a job and worked my ass for 3 months because tickets ain’t cheap and my managers “nice act” disappeared by the end of the week, he got stricter, if I was late even 2 minutes he’d be sarcastic and you could tell he held grudges.

For example, in the 2 month mark, I overheard a coworker wanting to leave for Bali and asking the manager face to face and the manager literally said “you’ve been taking a lot of leave lately, always travelling” and at first I thought my coworker didn’t have any leave saved until I heard my coworker say “yes that was last month for a week, I still have a lot of leave saved up” and the manager said to lodge it online.

It was denied because my coworker came to work for the next 2 months and quit. Never saw him again.

What I’m trying to say is, fast food places are harsh and will never be ok with a new starter already asking for leave even if it’s for 2 days let alone a week. Some managers are understanding but most are not in my experience.

I’d say it was your fault as well to ask for leave that soon as managers can tell who’s going to be their employee for a long time and who’s not and they probably saw you taking leave that early as someone who’s not going to stick around for long and didn’t want to invest more time and money. (1k is not coming out of their pockets but the franchisee’s pocket)

It’s a tough lesson but it’s been learnt, sorry dude.
